properties.name: Barkston Heath / Coningsby / Cranwell / Scampton / Waddington
notes: MATZ 3 NM radius; 2 NM stub; stub SFC-3000 FT AAL.
NATS Note 8: 5 NM radius portion of MATZ coincident with EG R313.

properties.name: Fairford
notes: NATS Note 1: aerodrome open on very limited occasions when advised by NOTAM or Supplement.

properties.name: Kinloss / Lossiemouth
notes: NATS Note 11: if Lossiemouth is closed, MATZ penetration service is provided by Kinloss Tower on 122.100 MHz (alternate 119.575 MHz).

properties.name: Lakenheath/Mildenhall CMATZ
notes: NATS Notes 2 and 3. Non-standard north-easterly stub SFC to 3000 FT AAL. Helicopters operating in EG D208 must notify Lakenheath ATC before penetrating the CMATZ; no restrictions within the overlapping north-easterly stub portion if at or below 800 FT AMSL.
NATS Notes 4 and 5. Non-standard extension to both stubs: 5 NM south of extended centre-lines. 5 NM circles joined by a straight line at their most easterly points; CMATZ with Lakenheath.

properties.name: Odiham
notes: NATS Note 10: Odiham Approach, except weekends and public holidays, when the task may be carried out by Farnborough on 125.250 MHz.

properties.name: Shawbury / Ternhill
notes: NATS Note 12: weekends and out of hours, contact Ternhill Radio for Traffic Information on 122.100 MHz.

properties.name: Warton
notes: NATS Note 7: 20 NM x 6 NM rectangle, major axis 071/251, offset 1 NM south.

properties.name: Wittering
notes: NATS Note 13: civilian traffic joining Wittering will be given Wittering Tower 127.975 MHz; do not free-call Wittering Tower for zone crossing service.
